full_source_validation.offset_convention: Zero-based Unicode character offsets, end exclusive.
reading_scope: For lengthy 1950.5, whole-file hash and exact span verified; the relevant subsection (n) and neighboring provisions inspected. Bulk output of the full file was truncated, so this is not a claim to have read every preceding provision.
Wrapper citations and references elsewhere in the full section were not imported into focused labels. Real excerpts have intact relevant expressions.
No live legal-currentness research performed or needed for source-bound textual labels.
full_source_validation.recheck: All ten saved-source hashes and exact excerpts were reverified. Case text remains unchanged; prior source-reading scope retained.

contract_findings.finding: A recognizable identification-only heading is now explicitly NO, while an isolated identifier with unknown role remains INSUFFICIENT. This is a coherent role distinction.
contract_findings.recommendation: Apply known heading status only when focus supplies recognizable heading context; do not use hidden case strata or external source labels to change the answer. The separate reviewer must test the new recognizable-heading boundary because original d029 only tests unknown role.

contract_findings.finding: A cut-off unnumbered Section can be YES when surrounding text establishes its public-legal sense. This correctly separates missing target identity from ambiguous pointer presence.
contract_findings.recommendation: Preserve contextual overrides: bare d031 remains INSUFFICIENT, numbered d045 YES, and explicit lease context NO. New clear-public-context truncation examples must be reviewed in the separately assigned candidate material.

contract_findings.finding: A substantive pointer in a heading counts, unlike a heading merely identifying its own unit. No original48 case changes answer under that clarification.
contract_findings.recommendation: Do not infer that all heading text is excluded by preparation; retain substantive heading pointers where they form part of scanned source content.

contract_findings.finding: The phrase definite body pointer in the INSUFFICIENT criterion is slightly narrower than the explicit instruction that substantive heading pointers count. The main instruction resolves the intended answer, so this is not a material case ambiguity.
contract_findings.recommendation: Optional editorial alignment is to say definite qualifying pointer rather than definite body pointer before final freeze; if changed, rebind exact question bytes and recheck reviews.

contract_findings.finding: The original48 include all prior failures but do not themselves establish the new recognizable-heading and unnumbered-public-context truncation contrasts.
contract_findings.recommendation: Use the independently reviewed retired candidate examples as additional development evidence. Do not call that retired set fresh evaluation after it informed dev3.

acceptance: Accepted for original48 development rerun under dev3. All48 labels remain unchanged; exact input hashes bound above. No material ambiguity found in these cases or the stated revisions. Separate review and development exercise of the newly exposed boundary cases remain necessary before fresh frozen evaluation.
